about: U.S. venture deal value (USD billions) and deal count by quarter, read from the 'Deal value ($B)' and 'Deal count' rows of the PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor's public summary spreadsheets. Figures and citations only.

vintageRule.mature: Quarter t and quarter t−4 are both read from the earliest retrieved release whose own quarter is at least t+4; with no such release, from the latest retrieved release, marked immature.
vintageRule.firstPublished: Quarter t and quarter t−4 are both read from the release that first published t, where it was retrieved.

unretrieved.reason: No public copy of the summary spreadsheet on nvca.org or in the Internet Archive's index of nvca.org uploads; NVCA described its spreadsheet data packs of that period as members-only.
The release's spreadsheet is not on nvca.org and the Internet Archive holds no copy of it.
